[[Major/Legends|Major]] '''Fisk Csino''' was a member of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Part of the [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Alliance Special Forces]], he specialized as a [[Wilderness Fighters|Wilderness Fighter]], and was the veteran of a dozen campaigns in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] by [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]]. Assigned to command the [[Nishr Taskforce]] in the wake of the [[Nishr Suppression]]&mdash;a crackdown by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces on rebellious [[Nish]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nishr]] in the Outer Rim&mdash;Csino led the unit throughout their [[Nishr Campaign|campaign]] against the local Imperial garrison.<ref name="RoE" />
